title: Holding Several Pocketwire Savings Vaults
content:
A customer may hold several Pocketwire Savings Vaults, up to the tier's maximum number of vaults that are not closed. A further vault is opened only if the customer holds fewer than that maximum of vaults whose status is anything other than closed. Every vault of a customer carries the same tier.

## What counts toward the maximum

The count is read from the customer's own vault records and their statuses, before the further vault is opened. Each vault is a separate record with its own name.

| Vault status | Counts toward the maximum |
|---|---|
| Opening | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| Time-locked | Yes |
| Frozen | Yes |
| Closed | No |

## Cases (hypothetical, a tier maximum of 3)

- The customer holds one active vault, one frozen vault and one vault still in opening status, plus two closed vaults. Three vaults count, which is not fewer than 3: no further vault is opened.
- The customer holds one active vault and one frozen vault, plus two closed vaults. Two vaults count, fewer than 3: the maximum does not stand in the way of a further vault.

## Basis Q&A

**Does a vault that has not yet been funded count?** Yes. A vault in opening status is not closed and counts.

**Does a closed vault count?** No. Only vaults whose status is anything other than closed are counted.

**Can two vaults of the same customer be on different tiers?** No. Every vault of a Pocketwire Savings Vault customer carries the same tier.
